span.normalized: On February 17, 2026, Core Natural Resources, Inc. (the “Company”) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 (the “Original Form 10-K”). This Amendment No. 1 to Form 10-K (“Amendment”) of the Company is being filed solely to amend Item 15 and Exhibit 96.1 to file an amended Technical Report Summary on the Leer Complex in Barbour, Harrison, Preston, and Taylor Counties, West Virginia. Due to administrative error, the Technical Report Summary that was filed with the Original Form 10-K included incorrect images for Figure 6.3-1 Stratigraphic Column and Figure 7.5-1 Drillhole Collar Locations.
